authorization: Publisher explicitly authorised three verified daily company-analysis articles on 2 November 2026, superseding the repository's one-new-article daily cap.
story_thesis: UPS is earning more per US package while handling fewer packages; the durability test is whether network productivity can outrun rising cost per piece rather than relying on price alone.

identity.units: USD millions except per-share, per-piece and volume data
identity.filing_scope_note: The Q3 earnings release is the current primary results document; the latest available Form 10-Q is the Q2 filing and is used only for programme and capital-spending context.

duplicate_checks: Checked editorial index, both inventories and actual wealth Markdown; UPS has a stock profile but no dedicated pricing, volume or automation analysis.
Checked open and recently merged pull requests and all recent company-publication records; no UPS publication attempt or matching fingerprint was active.
Checked live site content before drafting; no canonical article answers this question.
The article links the maintained /stocks/ups/ page and does not reproduce a routine quarterly table.

evidence_table.claim: US Domestic revenue was USD14.865bn, up 4.5%, with revenue per piece up 6.1%.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: Q3 release US Domestic segment table and bullets.

evidence_table.claim: Average daily US package volume fell to 15.621m from 16.150m, approximately 3.3%.
evidence_table.result: verified; article labels arithmetic as approximate

evidence_table.claim: Domestic GAAP operating profit was USD906m versus USD603m and adjusted profit USD1.034bn versus USD905m; margins were 6.1% GAAP and 7.0% adjusted.
evidence_table.result: verified; GAAP and adjusted figures remain separate

evidence_table.claim: Adjusted cost per piece was USD13.32 versus USD12.63, up 5.5%.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: Q3 release US Domestic operating statistics.

evidence_table.claim: Network and efficiency initiatives produced about USD1.8bn of benefits in nine months; UPS expects nearly USD3bn for 2026 and recorded USD1.4bn of 2026 costs and USD1.9bn cumulatively.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: Release strategy section and latest 10-Q transformation discussion.
evidence_table.result: verified as management statements; benefits are not presented as audited segment profit

evidence_table.claim: Nine-month operating cash flow was USD5.986bn, capex USD2.221bn and company-defined adjusted free cash flow USD4.220bn versus USD2.744bn.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: Q3 release cash-flow table; definition also includes disposal proceeds and other investing activities.
evidence_table.result: verified; article states the company definition

evidence_table.claim: Full-year guidance includes adjusted free cash flow around USD6.1bn, capex USD3bn, dividends around USD5.4bn and pension contributions USD1.3bn.
Group adjusted operating profit fell to USD2.054bn from USD2.132bn and adjusted margin to 9.0% from 10.0%.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: Q3 release consolidated results and non-GAAP reconciliation.

fact_check_pass.method: After drafting, material results, periods, segment labels, adjusted measures, guidance and arithmetic were reread against the SEC-furnished Q3 release; the Q2 Form 10-Q was used only where the article explicitly describes it as the latest available filing.
fact_check_pass.important_limit: The release describes a planned reduction from UPS's largest customer but does not identify that customer; the article deliberately does not name one.
